items.description: Founded in 2004 by Siva Narendra, Prabhakar Tadepalli and Tom Spitzer, under the premise “We believe in the power of the digitally connected world, but one needs digital trust for the connected world to become increasingly valuable.” We first applied this concept to the world of mobile banking transactions when smartphones were anticipated to gain traction. Our early work was done with the likes of Google, First Data, and the Department of Defense, focused on conveniently securing the identity of a digital user to enable transactions such as mobile payments. We had recognized our calling to secure online banking for the everyday consumer. Working alongside a handful of innovative credit unions (including two $10B in assets) tyfone launched our mobile banking platform. Leveraging our knowledge of convenience and user experience coupled with strong security, we relied on the expertise of our partners to bring our first iteration of mobile banking to life. A decade later, we threw the proverbial hand grenade at our “mobile only “solution and rebuilt our platform from scratch to be a modern, scalable, omnichannel solution that provides online banking services on any device, for both our retail banking customers and business banking clients. The new platform considers that user experience is critical for consumers as well as employees of our customers. Our solution envisions innovation in digital services as consumer digital interactions evolve (AI, augmented reality, virtual branches). Tyfone’s founding team members are inventors with more than 130 patents including several in financial services, that by themselves have attracted tens of million dollars in investments. Garden Valley School District is a Manitoba public school district with a student population of approximately 4,300. Their negligent attitude toward their own and their students' safety has resulted in the compromise of confidential student, staff, and health information, including student information system databases (names, dates of birth, grades, attendance, disciplinary and special education records), employee payroll records and bank account information, employee personnel files, accounting spreadsheets, student and staff data files, and district administrative records. This breach of information will result in a FIPPA/PHIA, notification to affected individuals, and potential penalties for violation.

Sunnier Homes es una inmobiliaria internacional con sede en Torrevieja (Alicante) que tiene como propósito cumplir el sueño de todas las personas que buscan un hogar para residir o invertir en el Mediterráneo. Con una larga trayectoria en la construcción y promoción de proyectos inmobiliarios de alta calidad en la Costa Blanca y Costa Cálida, Sunnier homes es conocedora del sector en todas las etapas del proceso ofreciendo un servicio integral. Experiencia, innovación y adaptación son los principios que marcan la relación con clientes, colaboradores y grupos de interés. Todo ello gracias a un equipo humano que acompaña y asesora a cada persona de forma individual para conseguir el hogar ideal.

About Bear Valley Community Hospital Bear Valley Community Healthcare District offers a wide range of emergency medical and healthcare services in Big Bear Valley, including urgent care, family health, and specialized medical treatments. Their services encompass various fields such as cardiology, behavioral health, rehabilitation, and dental care, catering to patients of all ages. The organization aims to provide high-quality healthcare regardless of insurance status, ensuring accessibility for the community. A Bear Valley Community Hospital suffered a cyberattack leading to the theft of over 400 GB of sensitive data. As a result of the data breach, employee data, the company’s confidential financial information, bank documents, patients’ personal documents, Social Security numbers, medical records, medical histories, and surgical records were stolen.

About MTM&O Gold Refinery DMCC MTM&O Gold Refinery DMCC is one of the largest refineries in the region and is a leader in terms of customer service, reliability, efficiency and quality. As a result of a hacker attack on one of the region’s largest gold refineries, documents were stolen.
